# CUEPA for You

> One-on-one AI help for everyday life. A one-hour video session with Marcos
> Cuellar and the CUEPA team for people who feel behind on AI. We set AI up
> around your life and build your own AI command center together.
> CUEPA for You is part of ELIPAN GROUP.

## What we do
- One-hour, one-on-one AI sessions for individuals, held over video call
- We get to know how your life runs, cut through the AI noise, and decide together what's worth learning, what AI should take off your plate, and what stays yours
- We set it up, connected and working, during the session
- No tech skills needed; beginners welcome

## What you leave with
Your CUEPA AI command center, a personal dashboard with:
- Your calendar
- The prompts and goals we write together during the session
- A weekly AI briefing from Marcos: what changed, what's worth trying, what's safe to skip

## Where
Virtual, over video call. Available anywhere.

## Who you work with
Marcos Cuellar and the CUEPA team. Marcos has been learning and studying AI
since it came out, and builds AI systems for businesses through CUEPA for Work.

## Who it's for
Individuals, not businesses: people with busy weeks, full inboxes and
families who feel behind or overwhelmed by AI.
For business and team work, see CUEPA for Work: https://www.makingcuepa.com/

## How booking works
1. Answer five quick questions on the website: where you'd like help, where you are with AI, the tools you use, one task, and your name and email
2. Review your answers and pick two or three preferred dates
3. Pay $129 securely through Stripe to confirm your purchase
4. Marcos emails you to confirm your session time
5. Meet for one hour over video and leave with your AI command center

## Pricing
$129 for one hour of one-on-one AI help over video, including your AI command center.

Email: marcoscuellar@elipangroup.com
